def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(a>0,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
    sizes=[(np.sum(lab==i),i) for i in range(1,n+1)]
    sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    boxes=[]
